project_type: Monorepo: Phaser 4.2.1 game engine + Next.js web app + Supabase database
build_system: pnpm + turborepo, packages: game-engine, shared, web, database, ui
test_framework: Vitest (game-engine, shared, web) with __tests__/ directories adjacent to source
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm format:check 2. pnpm lint 3. pnpm build 4. pnpm test
environment_constraints: No Docker daemon for db:verify. Tests must be locally runnable without hosted Supabase credentials.
contribution_requirements: Conventional commits, prettier 88 chars (pnpm format), 12 locales (en,ko,ja,zh,es,fr,de,pt,ar,hi,th,vi), files under 300 lines, ECS pattern: System base class with requiredComponents + pure ops functions in separate files, all user-facing strings as i18n keys (decision D8), no player-to-player trading, age 10-18 audience (no violence/gambling)
key_patterns: Components are pure data (extend Component with a type string). Systems extend System base with requiredComponents array. Pure logic ops live in domain folders (e.g. fishing/fishingOps.ts). Definitions are Record<string, Definition> or readonly arrays with i18n titleKey/descriptionKey. Items defined in @worldnest/shared items.ts as union type ItemId. NPC catalogue at world/NpcCatalogue.ts with NpcRole type. Locale messages are typed TS files (not JSON) at apps/web/src/i18n/messages/*.ts exporting LocaleMessages. Tests use describe/it/expect from vitest, create entities with components inline.
directory_structure: packages/game-engine/src/ - ECS core (ecs/), components (components/), systems (systems/), domain logic folders (fishing/, cooking/, achievements/, collection/, quests/, etc.), world generation (world/), tests (__tests__/). packages/shared/src/ - items, constants, economy, chat utils. apps/web/src/ - game UI, components, hooks, i18n, stores, tests. packages/database/ - Supabase migrations.
